source_title: WHO transition to community-based mental health guide
direct_observation: Deinstitutionalization requires system-wide policy law funding housing community services changed care and supported discharge
missing_stage: named person continuity recovery and agency

unit_or_scope: countries reporting to Mental Health Atlas
direct_observation: Only 9 percent of reporting countries had fully shifted and 53 percent remained at an early stage; involuntary and long stays remain common
missing_stage: country reform causing person-level recovery and reduced coercion
next_test: compare reform stage with community service and housing capacity

unit_or_scope: people leaving psychiatric institutions and communities
direct_observation: Housing health care social support education employment and family support are essential to community living
missing_stage: same-person stable housing participation and non-recurrence
next_test: join discharge records to housing income care and work outcomes

unit_or_scope: people with lived experience and families
direct_observation: Only a minority of responding countries reported ongoing collaboration in planning delivery or monitoring
missing_stage: equal decision power remuneration representation and feedback
next_test: audit whether lived-experience partners changed a service decision

direct_observation: Seclusion and restraint can cause injury trauma and mistrust; reducing coercion requires daily practice communication legal capacity and staff support
missing_stage: named crisis alternative safety recovery and remedy
